messages:
maria: opened PR #4567 with HSM policy examples for the on-prem installer. need another pair of eyes on the CLI snippets and JSON keys. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4567
sam: quick skim — the `KeyLabel` field looks non-standard, we usually use `key_label` in our examples
devon: @sam yep, we switched to snake_case in the last HSM refactor. also noticed the vpc peering section doesn't call out the route table propagation requirement for Azure. should add a note
alex: I can add the Azure route-table snippet + one-liner to verify peering
maria: nice. also the airgapped packaging section references a sha256 filename but the example shows `sha1sum` — needs fixing :facepalm:
devon: here's a corrected HSM policy example you can paste into the docs:
```json
{
  "hsm_policy_version": "2024-01",
  "key_label": "redwood-inference-root",
  "usage": ["sign","unwrap"],
  "roles": ["operator","kms-agent"]
}
```
sam: looks good. installer example suggestion:
```
./redwood-installer install --airgap-bundle /tmp/bundle.tgz \\n  --hsm-policy /etc/redwood/hsm_policy.json \\n  --skip-network-checks
```
maria: can we add a one-liner for confirming PKCS11 token presence?
alex: yes — `pkcs11-tool --list-slots` (note: requires pcscd on some distros)
devon: I'll update the PR text and add links to the VPC peering guide. changing checksum to `sha256sum` and adding macOS note: `shasum -a 256`
maria: great. last ask: can someone run a local doc build and paste the rendered snippet? CI sometimes hides a trailing backtick edge case
docs-bot: Build started for PR #4567 — preview URL: https://docs-preview.internal/4567 :construction:
sam: preview looks fine to me, HSM snippet renders and code block preserved. :thumbsup:
alex: pushed azure route-table snippet and a tiny diagram: https://img.internal/peering-az.png
devon: pushed fixes for snake_case, checksum, and installer flag examples
maria: thanks — i'll merge once CI completes and keep the PR open for post-merge review
sam: can we add a changelog entry in docs/releases.md so customers see the HSM example updates? minor
maria: yep adding that now
docs-bot: CI passed for PR #4567 — merged by maria
